newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pan Malayan to buy land for S$31 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pan Malayan to buy land for S$31 mln.

text.p: Property developer Pan Malayan Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday its subsidiary, Evansville Investments Pte Ltd, had signed a Singapore $31 million purchase option for a Singapore site.
The sum for the 1,280.4 sq m site in the central business district included S$1 million damages payable by the seller to its main contractor, a company statement said.
The purchase and construction costs would be financed by the net proceeds from the three-for two rights issue received by Pan Malayan in July 1996, it said.
